summary: Tested L.A. Technische Service single-page Dutch marketing site. Backend: 5/5 pytest tests pass (root, contact create, invalid email 422, short fields 422, list contacts no _id leak). Frontend: hero title 'Alles met Techniek.', all 4 stats (10+, 24/7, 100%, NL), 4 service cards, 3 project cards, nav scroll-to-section, original logo URL used in nav and footer (2 instances), contact form submission shows success message 'Bericht verzonden...'.

minor.issue: logger is referenced in except block but defined AFTER the route registration (line 119); a real Mongo failure inside the handler would raise NameError before returning the intended 500. Move logger init above routes.

action_items: (Minor) Move `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` initialization above route definitions in /app/backend/server.py so the except-handler in POST /api/contact uses the real logger instead of raising NameError on Mongo failures.
critical_code_review_comments: logger is used inside POST /api/contact except-block but defined after app.include_router; would cause NameError on real DB failures (currently happy-path so untested, but a latent bug).
Frontend invalid-email test relies on HTML5 type=email blocking submission; backend Pydantic EmailStr is the real guardrail (verified 422).
App.js (~800 lines) is a single file containing all sections; consider splitting components into /src/components for maintainability if site grows.
Contact form has no client-side rate limiting and POST /api/contact is unauthenticated — could be spam-abused; consider hCaptcha/honeypot in future.
seed_data_creation: Inserted a few TEST_-prefixed contact docs into Mongo `contacts` collection during testing (safe to leave or purge).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — reuse with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Public URL via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All UI elements use data-testid attributes documented in App.js (hero-title, hero-stat-{0..3}, service-card-{0..3}, project-card-{0..2}, contact-input-{name,email,subject,message}, contact-submit-button, contact-success-message, contact-error-message, nav-link-{diensten,over,projecten,contact}).
